zh.headline: 具百人團隊實戰經驗的技術長：為企業打造能扛大盤的好系統
zh.subHeadline: 百人團隊帶得動，複雜系統搞得定，商業問題講得清。技術長的工作，不只是把系統做出來，更要管得住成本、控制得了風險，讓團隊持續交付，讓企業放心做生意。

body.text: 企業真正稀缺的，是既有百人大型研發組織的管理經驗，又有足夠的底層技術深度——能在企業面臨重大技術決策與系統危機時做出正確戰略判斷，並親手建立技術基準、負責把決策徹底落地。十多年跨國技術管理與架構實戰，曾帶領跨國大型商務平台工程與外部 Vendor 團隊負責核心營運與架構維護，並整合跨國消費性電子品牌客服與 CRM / ERP 跨系統資料流，打通資訊孤島、提升營運交付效率。
頂級技術長（CTO）的 5 大決策承諾（經營層與董事會最關心的 5 大命題）
1.【戰略判斷】技術投資對齊商業增長，絕不讓架構走錯路
商業導向、拒絕盲目追新：技術選型若只挑時髦的，砸了幾千萬兩年後全盤作廢，就是業務擴張的最大絆腳石。我始終以未來 3–5 年的商業模型為依歸做技術選型；不為技術而技術，確保每一筆基礎建設投資都能實質承載業務規模化擴張。
2.【商業回報】算得清投入產出比（ROI），嚴控研發成本與隱性浪費
開源節流、精算商業回報：加錢堆機器、盲目擴編誰都會，那毫無技術含金量。全面審視技術架構的冗餘運算與研發人效，清理虛胖的雲端帳單；只用商業回報（降低履約成本、提高運營槓桿）與經營層對話，該花的錢要花，不該浪費的絕不亂燒。
3.【組織領導】百人團隊帶得動，建立高交付力的研發組織
建立基準、打造自主交付團隊：工程團隊擴大後往往效率腰斬、跨部門各自為政。以實戰標準建立工程文化與技術基準；親自管理過百人規模組織與跨國 Vendor 團隊，懂得立規矩、排權責、抓進度，讓組織具備持續自主交付的硬實力。
4.【風險承擔】在系統危機與複雜僵局面前，敢負全責掌控大局
隻身掌控大局、消除單點故障（SPOF）：關鍵時刻不甩鍋給外部廠商或前人技術債。具備深厚底層技術穿透力，面對銀行/金流/優惠/物流等多方渠道串接、單點故障與複雜商業毛線團時，親臨第一線排查瓶頸、設下防線，在系統面臨挑戰時穩住核心生意。
5.【執行落地】拒絕簡報技術長，複雜戰略穿透底層徹底落地
穿透底層、負責把決策做出來：開會畫架構圖很簡單，真正難的是把複雜戰略咬合交付。懂戰略高度，同時擁有親自動手的技術底氣；技術深度是用來驗證戰略是否可行並為團隊建立基準，把宏大戰略拆解成扎扎實實的交付成果。
有技術問題，歡迎直接談
1. 系統診斷／技術盡職調查（Tech Due Diligence）
系統太複雜、不知道該不該重構，或投資前想評估技術團隊的真實底層能力，可以先全面盤查架構瓶頸、程式碼品質與深層技術風險；梳理疊床架屋的毛線團資訊流與多方渠道串接摩擦，提供客觀診斷與開源節流方案。
2. 年度企業技術顧問（12-Month Retainer）
協助處理技術債、系統整合、雲端成本、架構規劃及研發團隊管理。依約定頻率參與架構檢視與技術決策、規劃電商與 CRM/ERP 串接，並協助面試與培育技術主管。
3. 技術長 / 研發部門負責人（CTO / VP of Engineering）
開放大型企業、跨國組織與科技公司的全職技術領導職務，從技術策略到實際交付都能參與。負責技術規劃、100+ 人工程團隊管理、核心平台改版與交付穩定度。
說了這麼多，實際做過什麼？
100+ 人研發組織與 Vendor 管理：帶領跨國大型商務平台工程與外部 Vendor 團隊，負責核心架構維護、多幣別結帳與營運穩定性。
跨國 CRM / ERP 跨系統整合：串接跨國消費性電子品牌客服、Salesforce、HubSpot、RingCentral 語音系統與 ERP 庫存資料流，打通跨部門資訊孤島，消除人工傳遞摩擦。

180+ GitHub 專案與主力線上系統：除了企業管理工作，也持續開發、部署與維護實際上線的產品。技術不是只停留在簡報裡。長期維運 6 大主力線上系統，包含 888 StockBot 2.0、888 StockQuant、888news 科技情報彙整、2MD (2md.aiurl.tw) 網頁與文件解析／PP-OCRv4 表格重建／個資去識別化引擎、DAVID888 Daily 語音播客與 333 奇門遁甲曆法決策系統。
有問題，不必急著決定合作。先把問題聊清楚比較重要。

en.headline: CTO with 100+ Team Scale: Architecting Resilient Systems That Drive Enterprise Growth
en.subHeadline: Leading 100+ person teams, mastering complex systems, and speaking plain business. A CTO's job goes beyond building software—it is about controlling costs, managing risk, keeping teams shipping, and giving the business peace of mind.

body.text: What enterprises truly lack is a leader who combines large-scale engineering organization management with deep technical mastery—able to make the right strategic calls during critical technology decisions, establish technical baselines, and take full ownership of execution. With over a decade of multinational leadership, I have led multinational commerce platform engineering and vendor teams managing core operations and architectural resilience, as well as integrated multinational consumer electronics CRM/ERP data flows to eliminate organizational silos and accelerate operational delivery.
5 Executive Decision Commitments of a Top CTO (Addressing the 5 Imperatives of Boards & CEOs)
1. [Strategic Judgment] Align Technology Investments with Business Growth, Never Stray

Business-Driven, No Trend-Chasing: Choosing technology simply because it is fashionable—wasting tens of millions only to scrap it two years later—is the single biggest drag on business expansion. I anchor technical roadmaps strictly to 3–5 year business models, ensuring every foundational investment genuinely enables multi-year scale.
2. [Business Return] Precision ROI Accounting, Eliminating Engineering Waste

Fiscal Discipline, Maximizing ROI: Anyone can solve problems by spending more money on servers or mindless hiring—that requires zero technical capability. I rigorously audit architectural compute overhead and developer output, trimming bloated cloud invoices. We talk purely in business returns (reducing fulfillment cost, increasing operational leverage). Spend where needed; burn nothing unnecessarily.
3. [Organizational Leadership] Leading 100+ Person Teams, Engineering High-Delivery Organizations

Setting Baselines, Building Autonomous Teams: As engineering orgs scale, delivery efficiency often plummets due to siloed communication. I establish practical engineering standards and technical baselines. Having directly managed 100+ person teams and external vendor partners, I institute clear ownership, robust cadences, and continuous delivery disciplines.
4. [Risk Ownership] Taking Full Command During System Crises & Complex Roadblocks

Eliminating SPOF, Total Accountability: When crisis hits, true leadership never passes blame to external vendors or legacy tech debt. Armed with deep architectural penetration, I step directly onto the front line during multi-channel integrations (banking, payments, promos, logistics), single points of failure (SPOF), and tangled data flows—locking down defenses and protecting business continuity.
5. [Execution & Delivery] No Slide-Deck CTOs—Penetrating the Bottom Layer to Deliver Results

Deep Grounding, Executing Decisions: Drawing architecture diagrams in boardrooms is easy; the real difficulty is aligning complex strategy into shipping software. I combine executive strategic vision with hands-on technical depth—using technical mastery not to show off, but to validate feasibility, establish baselines, and turn grand roadmaps into tangible business outcomes.
Have a Technical Challenge? Let's Talk Through It
1. Technical Due Diligence & System Diagnosis

For systems that feel too complex to touch, before deciding whether to refactor, or when evaluating technical health prior to investment. We thoroughly audit system architecture, codebases, and structural risks—untangling messy information flows and multi-channel integration friction, providing an objective diagnosis and thrift-oriented optimization roadmap.
2. Annual Technical Advisor (12-Month Retainer)

Guiding technical debt cleanup, system integration, cloud cost rationalization, architecture roadmaps, and engineering team mentoring. On an agreed rhythm, participating in architectural reviews, aligning e-commerce and CRM/ERP data flows, and mentoring future tech leads.
3. CTO / VP of Engineering

Open to full-time technology leadership roles for multinational corporations, listed groups, and high-growth technology companies. Overseeing technology strategy, managing 100+ person engineering teams, and elevating platform stability and delivery.
Key Track Record & Live Systems
100+ Person Engineering & Vendor Leadership: Led multinational commerce platform engineering and external vendor teams, managing core architecture, multi-currency checkout, and operational stability.

Multinational CRM / ERP Cross-System Integration: Integrated customer service, Salesforce, HubSpot, RingCentral telephony, and ERP inventory data flows for a global consumer electronics brand—breaking down departmental silos and eliminating manual friction.

180+ GitHub Repositories & Flagship Systems: Beyond enterprise management, actively building, deploying, and maintaining live products. Actively operating 6 flagship platforms: 888 StockBot 2.0 (valuation), 888 StockQuant (time-series forecasting), 888news (tech intelligence & MCP), 2MD (2md.aiurl.tw web/document parser, PP-OCRv4 table reconstruction & PII shield), DAVID888 Daily podcast, and 333 Qi Men Dun Jia calendar system.
Have questions? No need to rush into an engagement—let's talk through the problem first.
